scope: Real Chromium/SwiftShader WebGL2 desktop/phone-layout native J/two-tap ejection over original existing World.saf positions. Aircraft start, original ejection random draw and new encounter seed1 are explicit fixtures. Original simulation supplies all later chute motion, facing, terrain/building LOS, projectiles and crew injury. Seed1 deliberately exercises a positive random roll and does not establish natural encounter frequency or difficulty. No chute/camera/health/outcome assignment. Physical iPhone Safari and hardware FPS are not tested.
